---SIGNAL 1---
NAME: Industry Neutral Long History Three Channel
EXPRESSION: SUMRANK(IND_ZSCORE(MA(RATIO(ADD(ebitda, ADD(COALESCE(xsga, 0), ADD(COALESCE(xrd, 0), COALESCE(xad, 0)))), ADD(at, TS_SUM(ADD(COALESCE(xsga, 0), ADD(COALESCE(xrd, 0), COALESCE(xad, 0))), 5))), 3)), SUMRANK(IND_ZSCORE(RATIO(TS_SUM(ADD(COALESCE(xsga, 0), ADD(COALESCE(xrd, 0), COALESCE(xad, 0))), 5), ADD(at, TS_SUM(ADD(COALESCE(xsga, 0), ADD(COALESCE(xrd, 0), COALESCE(xad, 0))), 5)))), NEG(IND_ZSCORE(RATIO(ADD(COALESCE(intan, 0), COALESCE(gdwl, 0)), at)))))
HYPOTHESIS: Validated intangible productivity is a within-industry phenomenon: relative to peers using the same technology, firms with higher restated returns, larger unrecognized capital shares and smaller purchased intangible bases are underpriced.
EXPECTED_SIGN: positive
REASONING: The long-history three-channel composite is the archive's best all-around signal (FMB 3.69, alpha 5.9%, t-alpha 4.80 at 0.145 coverage), and industry neutralization previously improved the restatement's cross-sectional slope (3.72 to 4.02) by stripping the asset-light sector tilt. Applying it to all three channels before ranking should raise both the slope and the Sharpe, whose 0.417 is the composite's weakest diagnostic.
INTERACTION_TYPE: composite

---SIGNAL 2---
NAME: Cash Preferred Intangible Composite
EXPRESSION: COALESCE(SUMRANK(MA(RATIO(ADD(oancf, ADD(xsga, ADD(COALESCE(xrd, 0), COALESCE(xad, 0)))), ADD(at, TS_SUM(ADD(xsga, ADD(COALESCE(xrd, 0), COALESCE(xad, 0))), 5))), 3), SUMRANK(RATIO(TS_SUM(ADD(xsga, ADD(COALESCE(xrd, 0), COALESCE(xad, 0))), 5), ADD(at, TS_SUM(ADD(xsga, ADD(COALESCE(xrd, 0), COALESCE(xad, 0))), 5))), NEG(MUL(IND_RANK(RATIO(SUB(ib, oancf), at)), IND_RANK(RATIO(ADD(COALESCE(intan, 0), COALESCE(gdwl, 0)), at)))))), SUMRANK(MA(RATIO(ADD(ebitda, ADD(COALESCE(xsga, 0), ADD(COALESCE(xrd, 0), COALESCE(xad, 0)))), ADD(at, TS_SUM(ADD(COALESCE(xsga, 0), ADD(COALESCE(xrd, 0), COALESCE(xad, 0))), 5))), 3), SUMRANK(RATIO(TS_SUM(ADD(COALESCE(xsga, 0), ADD(COALESCE(xrd, 0), COALESCE(xad, 0))), 5), ADD(at, TS_SUM(ADD(COALESCE(xsga, 0), ADD(COALESCE(xrd, 0), COALESCE(xad, 0))), 5))), NEG(RATIO(ADD(COALESCE(intan, 0), COALESCE(gdwl, 0)), at)))))
HYPOTHESIS: The cash-flow-based restatement is the economically superior measure of intangible productivity, but where cash-flow data are unavailable the earnings-based restatement captures the same economics, so a preference-ordered fallback should dominate either version alone.
EXPECTED_SIGN: positive
REASONING: The two three-channel composites are the archive's best alpha (7.9%, Sharpe 0.59 at 0.078 coverage) and best coverage-robust signal (5.9%, t 4.80 at 0.145 coverage), and both output comparable rank-sum scales, so COALESCE is a measurement-availability fallback rather than a coverage patch. This is the natural final consolidation: it keeps the strongest measurement where it exists and triples the usable sample where it does not.
INTERACTION_TYPE: composite

---SIGNAL 3---
NAME: Committed Spend Four Channel Composite
EXPRESSION: SUMRANK(MA(RATIO(ADD(ebitda, ADD(COALESCE(xsga, 0), ADD(COALESCE(xrd, 0), COALESCE(xad, 0)))), ADD(at, TS_SUM(ADD(COALESCE(xsga, 0), ADD(COALESCE(xrd, 0), COALESCE(xad, 0))), 5))), 3), SUMRANK(RATIO(TS_SUM(ADD(COALESCE(xsga, 0), ADD(COALESCE(xrd, 0), COALESCE(xad, 0))), 5), ADD(at, TS_SUM(ADD(COALESCE(xsga, 0), ADD(COALESCE(xrd, 0), COALESCE(xad, 0))), 5))), SUMRANK(TS_MIN(RATIO(ADD(COALESCE(xrd, 0), COALESCE(xad, 0)), at), 5), NEG(RATIO(ADD(COALESCE(intan, 0), COALESCE(gdwl, 0)), at)))))
HYPOTHESIS: Persistent, non-discretionary intangible spending is a fourth independent mark of validated hidden capital, distinguishing committed innovators and brand builders from firms whose intangible share reflects one-off outlays.
EXPECTED_SIGN: positive
REASONING: The committed-spend floor performed well standalone (FMB 3.67, alpha 3.9%, t 3.11, Sharpe 0.47) and measures persistence rather than magnitude, so it carries information not spanned by the level, share or booked-intangible channels. Adding it to the coverage-robust composite tests whether commitment is incrementally priced without sacrificing the 0.145 coverage.
INTERACTION_TYPE: composite

---SIGNAL 4---
NAME: Goodwill Only Short Leg Composite
EXPRESSION: SUMRANK(MA(RATIO(ADD(ebitda, ADD(COALESCE(xsga, 0), ADD(COALESCE(xrd, 0), COALESCE(xad, 0)))), ADD(at, TS_SUM(ADD(COALESCE(xsga, 0), ADD(COALESCE(xrd, 0), COALESCE(xad, 0))), 5))), 3), SUMRANK(RATIO(TS_SUM(ADD(COALESCE(xsga, 0), ADD(COALESCE(xrd, 0), COALESCE(xad, 0))), 5), ADD(at, TS_SUM(ADD(COALESCE(xsga, 0), ADD(COALESCE(xrd, 0), COALESCE(xad, 0))), 5))), NEG(RATIO(COALESCE(gdwl, 0), at))))
HYPOTHESIS: Only goodwill unambiguously records overpayment for acquired intangibles, whereas identifiable purchased intangibles such as patents and licensed technology may be genuinely productive, so restricting the short leg to goodwill should sharpen the overstatement channel.
EXPECTED_SIGN: positive
REASONING: The archive has repeatedly bundled goodwill with other capitalized intangibles and never resolved which component drives the reliably negative side, and the standalone goodwill accrual test still produced a -3.9% alpha. Substituting goodwill for total booked intangibles inside the best coverage-robust structure isolates that question while keeping everything else fixed.
INTERACTION_TYPE: composite

---SIGNAL 5---
NAME: Weakest Link Intangible Quality
EXPRESSION: MIN(IND_RANK(MA(RATIO(ADD(ebitda, ADD(COALESCE(xsga, 0), ADD(COALESCE(xrd, 0), COALESCE(xad, 0)))), ADD(at, TS_SUM(ADD(COALESCE(xsga, 0), ADD(COALESCE(xrd, 0), COALESCE(xad, 0))), 5))), 3)), IND_RANK(NEG(RATIO(ADD(COALESCE(intan, 0), COALESCE(gdwl, 0)), at))))
HYPOTHESIS: A firm qualifies as a validated intangible producer only if it is strong on both dimensions at once — high restated return on total capital and a self-built rather than purchased intangible base — so the binding constraint, not the average, should determine the signal.
EXPECTED_SIGN: positive
REASONING: All prior combinations have been additive rank sums or products, which let one extreme channel compensate for a weak one; a minimum imposes a conjunctive requirement that should produce cleaner extreme portfolios and a monotone cross-section. It is a deliberate structural test at full coverage, and if it matches the multi-channel sums it shows the effect is driven by joint qualification rather than aggregation of separate signals.
INTERACTION_TYPE: novel

---SIGNAL 6---
NAME: Hidden Share Weighted Long History Return
EXPRESSION: MUL(IND_ZSCORE(MA(RATIO(ADD(ebitda, ADD(COALESCE(xsga, 0), ADD(COALESCE(xrd, 0), COALESCE(xad, 0)))), ADD(at, TS_SUM(ADD(COALESCE(xsga, 0), ADD(COALESCE(xrd, 0), COALESCE(xad, 0))), 5))), 3)), IND_RANK(RATIO(TS_SUM(ADD(COALESCE(xsga, 0), ADD(COALESCE(xrd, 0), COALESCE(xad, 0))), 5), ADD(at, TS_SUM(ADD(COALESCE(xsga, 0), ADD(COALESCE(xrd, 0), COALESCE(xad, 0))), 5)))))
HYPOTHESIS: Restated profitability should be priced in proportion to how much of the firm's true capital base is unrecognized, and this scaling relationship should hold across the full sample, not only in the cash-flow-statement era.
EXPECTED_SIGN: positive
REASONING: The hidden-share weighting structure has generated the archive's strongest cross-sectional slopes (FMB 4.99, 4.50, 4.38) but every version used oancf and was confined to 0.077-0.091 coverage, leaving its robustness untested. Rebuilding it on the ebitda restatement gives the highest-slope mechanism a full-sample test and tells us whether the weak alphas of the weighted family were a small-sample artifact.
INTERACTION_TYPE: conditional
